family_basis: Select John Glasco of Drumearn (Glasgow-2990) as Robert Glasgow-1189’s possible working father, at 31% subjective confidence. The specific reported father name John favours a John comparison over the automated leading candidate James Glasgow-1970. The actual 1766 Derryloran return places John at Drumearn beside two James Glasco households, three years before Robert’s estimated birth. That supplies a real Tyrone father-generation account compatible with the reported origin. John’s circa-1750 local estimate and the contributed father’s 1745 year are both unproved; either permits fatherhood around 1769, and no date is changed to fit. The estimate assesses the whole proposition that the documented householder was the reported father. It is not a rating of the census record, a statistical probability, or a product of the uncertain ancestry above John.
limitations: There are two unresolved steps: whether the contributed John/Margaret parentage is correct, and whether that John was the Drumearn householder. A common given name, estimated generation and claimed county cannot establish identity. The 1766 return supplies no wife, child, age or parent; the nearby James entries do not identify John’s father. Robert’s Tyrone birthplace is not independently established by the inspected Geneanet page. John’s existing uncertain James Glasgow-2988 father is preserved, with no new support. The Cookstown reward subscriber of 1796 is an unresolved namesake comparison, with Robert Glasgow-3941 the stronger maintained candidate; that notice supplies no parent and is not used as proof that the Martinsburg man lived at Cookstown. The single Geneanet/Ancestry family-tree chain and its repetition in WikiTree are not independent witnesses. Retain another unidentified Irish John as a serious alternative. John Glasgow-3314, associated with Margaret Mill and the West Calder children of 1762–1770, matches both reported parental given names and a viable generation, but has no inspected Robert or Irish-origin bridge. His Scottish baptism and actual West Calder household are distinct facts; an unproved Irish birthplace is not a categorical exclusion. John Glasgow-4179 of Larne also fits the estimated generation; his known Rose Allan marriage does not prove there was no earlier Margaret, but no record connects him with Robert or Drumearn. James Glasgow-1970 has a Cookstown family tradition and a rare Julia/Julia Ann descendant-name resemblance; those are useful regional clues, but do not outweigh the specific reported John father name. If that report is wrong, James or another local man remains possible. No competing candidate is rejected merely for missing fields. No mother is selected: the reported Margaret is not identified with Margaret Mill, Rose Allan or any existing profile, and Nee is not adopted as a verified birth surname. Robert’s wife Elizabeth and every existing child remain unchanged. No merge, vital-field change, live WikiTree save or confidence upgrade is made.
